title: mapania pandanophylla

It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues, thanks to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Mapania pandanophylla include reducing inflammation, fighting bacterial infections, and providing relief from respiratory issues, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
